CustomField.description: When this renewal-timeline entry happened. Orders the append-only Renewal Activity timeline; same-transaction rows share a timestamp and tie-break on Name. Replaces Entry_Date__c, whose _Date suffix asserted a date-only type it never had - this field stores date AND time, per ARCHITECTURE.md §1 rule 9.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Date AND time this renewal activity actually happened - not when it was logged. Backdate it if you are recording an earlier conversation; the timeline is ordered newest-first by this value.
CustomField.label: Entry DateTime
